name: Official mHC without attention VE
tagline: Native four-stream mHC with the attention value tables removed.
description: The native mHC implementation is used directly. Attention V is computed from the contextual hidden state and the standard learned input smear stays enabled. The final residual streams are summed.
mechanism: Flattened 4×1536 stream with parameter-free RMSNorm and one 6144×24 projection for read, write and mixing logits
Read = σ, write = 2σ; residual mixing = 20 log-space Sinkhorn-Knopp normalizations (rows sum to one, columns approximately)
Four full-attention streams, 23 layers, FFN width 6016; native sum readout
limitations: A separate 8,000-update ablation using the current public mHC implementation. The local random-output-initialized Chord and Standard comparison points use a different branch initialization.
